predictions.quote: We're already down to 6% unemployment. We're going to be down to, I'd say probably 3 or 4% in two quarters.
predictions.prediction: U.S. unemployment, at about 6% in early March 2021, will fall to approximately 3–4% within two quarters (by around September 2021).

predictions.quote: I said, it's coming. I'm going to put another marker out there. Um, by the way, because like, you know, there may be something like this in New York.
